design: Post-RUN15 diagnostic follow-up; not a preregistered confirmatory test
question: How do the frozen WB and xDEM Nuth-Kaab implementations differ after controlling accepted graph topology and raster support?
sources: Exact reviewed completed Windows RUN14 and RUN15, verified by canonical JSON and logical raster fingerprints
pair_estimates: Reuse frozen accepted pair translations; do not refit, change thresholds, use rejected pairs or infer new edges
common_edges: Intersection of WB and xDEM accepted directed pairs for each fixed reference mask
connectivity: Require one connected component spanning all four epochs. Disconnected common graphs are not_identifiable; no four-epoch offsets are estimated for them.
network: Unchanged Workbench 0.10.1 equal-edge-weight translation least squares, epoch 0 anchored to zero; no calibrated covariance model
controls: Original accepted graphs reproduced from their frozen offsets
Common graph solved with identical edge keys for both implementations
shared_support: RUN15 common support intersected with finite values at all four epochs of all comparable original/common variants. Same pixels used for every region, method and time pair.
reference_regions: H_N and H_W intersect optical_common_clear_land; W_SLUMP is the frozen comparison window, not a confirmed geomorphic inventory or stable reference.
points: Original coordinates and containing grid cells, without relocation. Missing height remains missing; on_common_support identifies valid comparison support.
raster_outputs: Common-network DoD TIFFs and contrast TIFFs are masked to common_graph_support. Four-band epoch stacks retain per-variant support; use the common mask for comparisons.
resampling: Same Workbench apply_vector bilinear sampling as RUN15; original stacks reopened and fingerprint-checked or exactly reconstructed only when permitted.
statistics: Descriptive statistics and local projection-corrected ground area. No volume, significance test, confidence interval or automatic method winner.
contrast_arithmetic: For paired contrasts, float32 stored elevations are cast to float64 before subtraction. DoD contrasts are xDEM minus WB. Median of pixelwise contrast is not a difference of medians.
decomposition: Original software contrast = common-graph software contrast + graph-selection contribution, checked per node and per pixel. Descriptive algebra, not a causal or ground-truth attribution.
missing_inputs: Fail and preserve diagnostics. Never use uploaded low-resolution preview TIFFs as scientific inputs.
limitations: Common-edge control conditions on pairs accepted by both implementations and does not rank general robustness.
Graph closure and software agreement cannot establish absolute elevation accuracy.
Candidate reference surfaces may still change through snow, vegetation or ground processes.
Temporal dependence, spatial covariance and independent field accuracy remain uncalibrated.
